profile.title: Psychology Graduate & Educator
profile.bio: I am a University of Manitoba graduate with a passion for human behavior, child development, and research. With hands-on experience mentoring children through the YMCA-YWCA of Winnipeg, I bring a supportive, analytical, and empathetic approach to everything I do.

education.description: Edit this entry in the admin panel (Education tab, coming in session 3).

experience.description: Worked with children in elementary schools to support their academic, social, and emotional development. Designed and led activities that fostered curiosity, cooperation, and confidence.
